D.</ls> rejected, discarded. .³({%b%}) To leave, abandon, desert, quit, retire or withdraw from; यदि समरमपास्य नास्ति मृत्योर्भयम् <ls>Ve. 3. 5</ls>. .²2 To scare, disperse, drive away; अपास्य चास्य यन्तारम् <ls>Mb.</ls> .²3 To leave behind, leave in a deserted condition; to disregard, take no notice of, condemn.
